subject.title: skill_workshop apply times out ("Approval timed out") on large proposals (~28KB)

question: Should the fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498 bind Skill Workshop lifecycle approval to the proposal revision shown to the operator before this issue is closed?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not whether the bug exists; it is the maintainer-owned security boundary for approving generated skill content after proposal metadata is shown.

options.title: Bind Revision Before Merge
options.body: Require the lifecycle action to reject or re-prompt if the pending proposal changed after approval metadata was generated.

options.title: Accept Mutable Approval Risk
options.body: Merge the current PR behavior and explicitly accept that approval metadata is advisory if proposals are revised concurrently.

options.title: Use Timeout-Only Fix
options.body: Pursue the narrower timeout-only PR path and leave prompt metadata/revision binding to a separate follow-up.

recommendation.title: Bind Revision Before Merge
recommendation.body: Require the lifecycle action to reject or re-prompt if the pending proposal changed after approval metadata was generated.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned to this issue and authored the newer open PR that closes the timeout cluster.
